variants.prompt: REFORM OUTFIT/ATTIRE: On the sleek deck of a luxury yacht at dusk, the fiery-haired beauty wears a tight, skintight leather bodysuit in deep burgundy, the glossy material hugging every curve as she leans against the railing, her long legs crossed and boots kicked off to the side.
